`ShortcutService` has five RPCs, all implemented in a single backend file: `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`.

RPC names (declared in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`, lines 14–52):

- `ListShortcuts` — `ListShortcutsRequest` → `ListShortcutsResponse`, HTTP `GET /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`
- `GetShortcut` — `GetShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, HTTP `GET /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`
- `CreateShortcut` — `CreateShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, HTTP `POST /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`
- `UpdateShortcut` — `UpdateShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, HTTP `PATCH /api/v1/{shortcut.name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`
- `DeleteShortcut` — `DeleteShortcutRequest` → `google.protobuf.Empty`, HTTP `DELETE /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`

Implementing file: `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`, where each RPC is a method on `*APIV1Service` — `ListShortcuts` (line 49), `GetShortcut` (line 95), `CreateShortcut` (line 135), `UpdateShortcut` (line 211), and `DeleteShortcut` (line 284). The same file also holds two unexported helpers, `extractUserAndShortcutIDFromName` and `validateFilter`, plus `constructShortcutName`, which are not RPCs.

Generated (non-hand-written) plumbing for the service lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service_grpc.pb.go`, `proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service.pb.gw.go`, and `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/shortcut_service.connect.go`; tests are in `server/router/api/v1/test/shortcut_service_test.go`.
